tools.name: search_french_companies
tools.description: Finds French companies by name, acronym, former name, SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits), tolerating typos. Returns for each: siren, siret_siege (head office SIRET), numero_tva (active EU VAT number, null if none), nom, code_postal, ville, code_naf, activite, etat (active or fermee), opposition_u

tools.name: french_business_barometer
